en: Now. Listen to part two of the interview.
zh: 现在请听访谈的第二部分。

en: Questions 6 to 10 are based on part 2 of the interview.
zh: 第6至10题根据访谈的第二部分提问。

en: Do you think the global community has a responsibility to address that?
zh: 您认为国际社会有责任解决这一问题吗？

en: Well, I think the global community always has a responsibility to any humanitarian crisis.
zh: 我认为，面对任何人道主义危机，国际社会都有责任采取行动。

en: And I think it’s in our best interest to address a humanitarian crisis on this scale
zh: 而且，解决如此大规模的人道主义危机，也最符合我们自身的利益，

en: because displacement can lead to a lot of instability and aggression.
zh: 因为人口流离失所可能引发严重的动荡和攻击行为。

en: We certainly don’t want that.
zh: 这显然是我们不希望看到的。

en: A lot of people feel it’s a little calmer now... this is the time to really discuss and, and try to get these communities back together.
zh: 很多人觉得，现在局势稍微平静了一些……正是时候认真讨论，努力让这些社区重新团结起来。

en: But if these communities don’t start coming back together properly,
zh: 但如果这些社区没有开始妥善地重新凝聚起来，

en: if we don’t start really counting the people... understanding where they are... what they need...
zh: 如果我们没有真正开始统计人数，了解他们在哪里、需要什么……

en: making sure the schools are being built... making sure the electricity, the water and all these needs are being met
zh: 确保学校得到建设，确保供电、供水以及其他各项需求得到满足……

en: and also understanding that a lot of the people that will return are going to come back to houses that are occupied or destroyed and bombed out...
zh: 同时还要认识到，许多准备返回的人会发现，自己的房屋已经被占用、被毁坏，或被炸得无法居住……

en: It’s going to be a big operation to understand the needs... to address it, to help people put the pieces of their life back together and return to their communities.
zh: 了解这些需求、着手解决问题，帮助人们重新拼起破碎的生活、回到自己的社区，将是一项庞大的工作。
vocabulary: put the pieces of one's life back together

en: So it’s really just getting the plan together... getting the group together and everybody actively focused on helping the refugees.
zh: 所以，关键就在于统筹好计划，组织好团队，让每个人都积极投入帮助难民的工作。

en: What would be the message that you would want to carry out of here back home
zh: 您希望从这里带回国内怎样的信息，

en: or even the message that you would want to get out internationally in terms of what’s happening here... the refugee crisis...
zh: 或者说，向国际社会传递怎样的信息，内容涉及这里正在发生的事情、这场难民危机，

en: the consequences that could happen in the future if it’s not properly addressed?
zh: 以及如果处理不当将来可能带来的后果？

en: I always hate speculation on the news, so I don’t want to be somebody who speculates.
zh: 我一向不喜欢新闻中的猜测，因此也不想成为随意猜测的人。

en: Um but I think it’s clear that a displaced unstable population is what happens in Iraq,
zh: 但我认为很清楚，伊拉克目前存在着大量流离失所、生活不稳定的人口；

en: and how Iraq settles in the years to come is going to affect the entire Middle East.
zh: 而伊拉克在未来几年如何安定下来，将影响整个中东。

en: And a big part of what is going to affect how it settles
zh: 影响伊拉克如何安定下来的一个重要因素，

en: is how these people are returned and settled into their homes into their community and brought back together
zh: 就是这些人将如何返回、如何在家园和社区安顿下来并重新聚在一起。

en: and whether they can live together and what their communities look like, so it does have broad implications.
zh: 还包括他们能否共同生活，以及他们的社区会是什么样子。因此，这件事的影响确实很广泛。

en: On a personal level why is this so important to you... you willing to come here and risk your life?
zh: 从您个人的角度来说，为什么这件事如此重要，值得您冒着生命危险来到这里？

en: Uh, it was a very easy choice to make.
zh: 对我来说，这个选择很容易作出。

en: I felt I had to come here because it is very difficult to get answers about especially the internally displaced people.
zh: 我觉得自己必须来，因为要了解情况、尤其是了解境内流离失所者的情况，实在非常困难。

en: It’s as I said even U.N.H.C.R. who I traditionally work with — they are not able to be inside at the moment
zh: 正如我所说，就连一直与我合作的联合国难民署，目前都无法在境内开展工作。

en: and so I was very frustrated and just getting a bunch of ideas and papers but not knowing what’s really going on,
zh: 因此，我感到很沮丧：收到的只是许多想法和书面材料，却不知道实际发生着什么。

en: so today I’m able to talk to all different people from our government and their government and
zh: 所以，今天我能与我国政府和伊拉克政府的不同人员交谈，

en: really get some answers as to what is holding up the processes to really assist these people properly.
zh: 真正弄清楚：究竟是什么拖延了程序，使这些人迟迟得不到妥善援助。

en: Do you think that you in your position can try to push this process forward, but... pressure perhaps on our government?
zh: 您认为，凭借您的地位，能否推动这个进程，比如……也许可以向我国政府施压？

en: To put pressure on our government?
zh: 向我国政府施压？

en: Yes, or to try to just put pressure in general... create awareness?
zh: 对，或者只是从总体上施加一些压力……让大家关注这件事？

en: I certainly think creating awareness.
zh: 我当然认为，提高大家的关注度很重要。

en: I spoke to the officials from our government today about meeting our goal and they still intend to reach that goal.
zh: 今天，我和我国政府官员谈到了实现目标的问题，他们仍然打算达成这一目标。

en: You know there are many different people who can be cynical or say well how are they going to do it,
zh: 有些人可能会冷嘲热讽，或者说：“他们打算怎么做到呢？”

en: and I will ask them how are you going to do it and is there some way we can help to... you know.
zh: 而我会直接问他们：“你们打算怎么做到？我们有没有办法帮忙……”

en: OK. Thank you Angelina for talking to us.
zh: 好的。安吉丽娜，谢谢您接受我们的采访。

en: Pleasure.
zh: 很高兴能接受采访。

en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。

en: Questions six to ten are based on what you have just heard.
zh: 第6至10题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。

en: Question 6. Why should the global community help address the refugee problem?
zh: 为什么国际社会应该协助解决难民问题？

en: Question 7. What is NOT mentioned by Angelina in terms of helping refugees?
zh: 在帮助难民方面，安吉丽娜没有提到哪一项？

en: Question 8. What can BEST explain what the global community should do?
zh: 哪种表述最能说明国际社会应该做什么？

en: Question 9. According to Angelina, what is the key issue in solving the refugee problem?
zh: 根据安吉丽娜的看法，解决难民问题的关键是什么？

en: Question 10. Why did Angelina see her trip to Iraq significant?
zh: 为什么安吉丽娜认为自己的伊拉克之行意义重大？

en: This is the end of part one: listening comprehension.
zh: 第一部分听力理解到此结束。
